content: Walewalehiu, lolowa Yaubada tuwegana a neiyahi uyahimi po a ibaabaniyeya ega u baha hanahanapugei
ma nugonugou ipa Yesu Keliso tunawa hotana binei a wiatatiyana uyahimi, tauna hi lihilageni ani take uyahina.
Uyahinei a laugeletahi uyahimi mei tu tapitapiya po anai nugoheleleu po anai matoutau.
Ma gasi u luguguya uyahimi ega baha kadikadidilahi bo baha hanahanapugei, tamogi Alugo Woiyawa a kadidiligei,
ipa u luguguya ona nonoli po ona witumagana ega u winugonugotuhugei ma Yaubada a kadidiligei.
Hanapu dumana Yaubada uyahinei taumi tu nugomagula uyahimi a ibaabaniyeya, tamogi hipuli hanapuna po tu taniwagena hai hanapu apo hina yababa.
Ma lolowa Yaubada a hanapu gowagowadana ma geka hougana amaka i wogeleteya naka hipuli muliyei i wiwawali ma ata wasawasa tauna i nugotuhu tahaeya.
Hipuli tu taniwagena hanapu geka ega hita galena tuhagaya. Itapa hita hanapugeya apega ata Guyau waiwasawasana hita lihilageni hoi ani take.
Geka binei ma Yaubada a Buka i bahebaheya i pa,

content.text: po u nugonugohi ega ita lugeleteya
naka Yaubada tu luhogalena ubeita i wononogogeya.’

content: Yaubada Alugona uyahinei a hanapu gowagowadana e woogeleteya uyahita. Yaubada Alugona ginouli atapuhi i hanapugehi, yaka Yaubada a nugotuhu gowagowadahi i hanapugehi po e woogeleteya uyahita.
Ta nugotuhu meta tauta lawa, apo iyai a nugotuhu gowagowada lawana alugona i hanapugena meya. Naka pitena gasi Yaubada Alugona, Yaubada a nugotuhu i hanapugeya.
Ma Alugona uyahita e memae naka Yaubada uyahinei ma ega hipuligei, yaka Yaubada anani’mbenena uyahita ta gagalena tuhagahi.
Naka binei ega tauyai i winugonugotuhugei ma Alugo Woiyawa a nugotuhugei to ibaabani uyahimi po o galena tuhaga babana Alugona Woiyawa i wihogomi.

Ma tauhi tu meuputa Alugo Woiyawa a nugutuhu ega hita galena tuhagaya babana uyahihi ipa ginouli buubuwana. Ega emoemotahi ginoulihi hina hanapugehi matababana Yaubada Alugonei ega hita inugohiyahiyawa.
Tauta tamogi ginouli atapuhi Yaubada Alugonei ta ikaha imahiyehi, po ega iyai gehouna ipa ina libahibahita.
Mei Yaubada a Buka i bahebaheya i pa,

content.text: ‘Ega iyai gehouna Guyau a nugotuhu ita hanapugeya.
Ega iyai gehouna emoemotana po ina wiatatiyeya.’

content: Tamogi tauta Keliso a nugotuhugei ta inugonugotuhu.
